title: The Gutenberg Bible is completed at Mainz
summary: The Gutenberg Bible was probably completed in Mainz late in 1455. Its production used movable metal type in a major early European printing project.

citations.note: Supports the factual summary and chronology. Context includes explicitly interpretive comparisons; the date note identifies limits of precision.

claims.text: The Gutenberg Bible was probably completed in Mainz late in 1455. Its production used movable metal type in a major early European printing project.
Probable completion year, not an exact day.
This European milestone belongs alongside earlier East Asian printing histories. It is not a claim that Gutenberg invented printing everywhere or that textual reproduction began in Europe.
